relevance_note: Case series of 17 HA20 patients from six families with per-family TNFAIP3 variants and some per-patient details: "17 patients from 6 families with heterozygous likely loss-of-function variants in TNFAIP3".
method_note: Built with a short Python script from my own reading; all spans checked verbatim by script. Labels: the text uses 'pt1'...'pt17' (also 'p7', 'p10', 'p14'); 'ptN' used throughout, matched to the numbers in the 'Pt' column of Supplementary Files 1 and 3. STACKED CELLS (v6, D-31): in Supplementary File 1 (columns Age at analysis, Age at onset, Recurrent fever, Oral aphthosis, Genital ulcers, Gastrointestinal disease, Arthritis/ tenosynovitis, Skin disease, NPI, Autoimmunity, IS, CXCL9, CXCL10, PGA, CRP) and Supplementary File 3 (ANA, Other autoimmune laboratory findings, Treatments), the rows for families 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 hold ' / '-stacked values with no per-patient labels; none was assigned by position, so those fields are 'not reported' for pt1-8 and pt10-17. A single '+' in a multi-patient family row was also not applied to every member: column totals (e.g. genital ulcers 8 and recurrent fever 9 in Table 1) show a single '+' stands for one stacked line, not the whole row. Values printed once per family row and clearly family-level (Family, Variant, ACMG class) were applied to every patient in that row. Family 4 (pt9) is a single-patient row and was read directly. Zygosity 'heterozygous' and ethnicity 'European' come from statements about all 17 patients. Variant type left 'not reported' except pt9 (named CNV); 'truncating variants resulting in stop codon' was not mapped to an enum class. Inheritance left 'not reported': the paper says 'All but one variants were inherited in an autosomal dominant pattern' and that the exon 7-9 deletion was 'de novo', but does not state parental testing per person; the '*parents, **grandparents' footnote refers to pedigrees (figure) and no parent-child pairs are stated. is_proband left null (no proband named). 'Age at analysis' for pt9 (11) was put in age_at_last_evaluation; units not printed in the column (ages in years per Figure 2 '(y)'). pt9 CRP 0.54 mg/dl was not converted into 'elevated inflammatory markers' (the PGA definition combines CRP and ESR thresholds). pt9 '-' under other autoimmune laboratory findings is undefined, so 'autoantibodies (ANA/other)' is 'not reported' (ANA negative is narrower). Neuropsychiatric diagnoses (ADHD, anxiety, mood dysregulation, ODD, pica, depression) were recorded as features but not as checklist 'central nervous system involvement'. 'Seven patients presented neuropsychiatric symptoms' (named via 'Among these') was not used to exclude neuropsychiatric symptoms in the other ten. 'leading in one case to suicide attempt' (pt16 or pt17) not assigned. SLE exclusion for all 17 from 'none of the patients in our cohort fulfilled the classification criteria for SLE'. No contradictions affecting per-person values; the Results text writes 'pArg183Ter' where the table has 'p.Arg183Ter'.
